## Technical Expertise
- **Frontend Core:** React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Three.js
- **Backend Core:** Node.js, Express.js, Ballerina, Python, System Architecture, RESTful APIs
- **Databases:** Relational (SQL), NoSQL
- **Domains:** Responsive Web Design, Cybersecurity Analytics, Performance Optimization, and SEO/AIO.

## Selected Work
- **Graha:** Vedic astrology engine using Swiss Ephemeris and NASA JPL Horizons reference data. https://graha.chutte.dev
- **Eventure:** Event management and ticketing platform built with Ballerina; top 10 of 500+ teams at WSO2 Innovate with Ballerina.
- **NotifIBM:** Results-notification service for NIBM students; contributor to the NIBM Gold Medal.
- **WhatsApp AI Assistant:** Serverless AI assistant with hybrid Groq and Hugging Face inference.
